test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'even'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the adverbial meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• even - used in comparisons for emphasis.
 
• further - used to emphasize the difference between a supposed or suggested fact or state of mind and the truth.
 
• rather - used to indicate one's preference in a particular matter.
 
• quite - to the utmost or most absolute extent or degree; absolutely; completely.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs an adverb to describe the succeeding adjective lesser. 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that "even" fits the blank correctly. 
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer. 

 

Correct passage__* - **Concerned and responsible Indian citizens can encourage sensible consumption (1) behaviour. This can be done by shopping less and wasting (2) __even__ lesser; by buying local products to keep the cottage industries and (3) traditional crafts alive. In essence, by valuing their rich(4) heritage and living simple and meaningful lives, Indians can set (5) a precedent and show the west that India is much more than a well of business opportunities.*
